Mina (CS): EmeraldNet needs a short promo run — route to me-east-1, partner CIDR allowlist, SAML SSO, and temporary QPS bump (~14 days). They mentioned a Private deploy + KMS ask; renewal may depend on residency docs.

Farid (EmeraldNet): Dates 2025-05-02 -> 2025-05-16, peak 08:00-22:00 GST. Baseline 300 QPS; request burst to 1.2k for /v1/generate. CIDRs: 195.120.5.0/24 and 195.120.6.14/32. Egress ~320Mbps.

Jo (NetOps): Please confirm CIDRs (got them) and whether client certs required. We can open peering to me-east-1; will reserve PoP if available.

Farid (EmeraldNet): No client certs for now, token auth only. Auto-revoke on allowlist required.

Tess (Solutions Eng): Plan: 1) ephemeral allowlist auto-revoke 2025-05-17; 2) temp profile "emerald-promo-1200" scoped to me-east-1 and route tag emerald-promo; 3) 30m SAML setup call; 4) start Private/KMS discovery.

Abe (AE): Renewal flag 025: they want region-residency log bundle + KMS isolation note. I'll draft attestation and loop in Security.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-9811 created. PoP reservation ETA ~20h. Promo profile applied to staging; auto-revoke scheduled.

Jo (NetOps): Provision checklist in CS-9811: peering request, apply allowlist 195.120.5.0/24 & 195.120.6.14/32, promo profile emerald-promo-1200 active 08:00-22:00 GST, alert at 75% capacity -> notify @Mina.

Mina (CS): Booked SAML call tomorrow 10:00 GST. Renewal artifact owned by Abe. Ping here for updates.

Farid (EmeraldNet): Thanks team, ensure allowlist auto-revokes and audit logs available.

(END)
